title: Adaptive Pair-Measurement Design and Information Regret in Randomized Clusters of Size Two
banked_reason: D0.5 general referee capped the delivered paper at subfield (paper_score_ceiling 7.1 < 7.4); the promised matched predictable minimax order remains an n^-1/2 versus sqrt(log n/n) bracket.

proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved a sharp n^{-1/3} frozen two-wave frontier, a sequential n^{-1/2} lower bound, an explicit O(sqrt(log n/n)) upper policy, and honest inference for the constructed policies. Three D0 solve rounds did not close the log-free upper bound promised by the topic, so the predictable minimax order remains open. The math review passed, but the calibrated general review capped the delivered package at subfield, below the field floor.
tldr: In randomized clusters of size two, singleton measurements identify member means, while only paired measurements identify the association governing the extra value of pairing. For \(0<\varepsilon<1/6\), frozen post-pilot policies have sharp minimax information regret \(n^{-1/3}\). Every predictable policy obeys the lower bound \(n^{-1/2}\), and the explicit finite logged policy attains \(O_\varepsilon\{\sqrt{\log(n)/n}\}\); this is an honest bracket, not a sharp predictable order. The logged upper is \(o(n^{-1/3})\), proving a strict asymptotic benefit from within-wave adaptation. At high interiority, a sufficient stable pair-only phase admits an \(O_\varepsilon(n^{-1})\) two-wave upper bound, but no matching converse or exact phase boundary is claimed. For the frozen, logged, and conditional log-free policies, an independent paired training prefix and pathwise acquisition floors yield uniform martingale studentization, consistency for realized quadratic variation, and uniformly honest \(90\%\) ATE intervals. The logged scored-suffix information gap is \(O_\varepsilon\{\sqrt{\log(n)/n}\}=o(1)\).
gap: Static planned-missing designs optimize known pattern information, while Clip-OGD, Adaptive Neyman Allocation, and optimistic AIPW algorithms learn scalar treatment exposure from arm-outcome feedback. None learns pair-only association under a fixed randomized treatment, handles a nonlinear continuous pattern program with mixed optimal supports, proves sharp frozen and predictable regret uniformly over unrestricted compatible potential-outcome couplings, and links acquired patterns to realized-information inference.
fill: The project defines coupling-uniform target information on singular designs, proves the two-wave frontier and sequential converse, formalizes non-representability by scalar treatment-allocation feedback, leaves the log-free full-support policy as the named Stage-0 open obligation, and makes inference conditional on a policy satisfying that obligation.
